[[File:Cycle Shop Pt.png|frame|Rad Rickshaw (top left)]] '''Rad Rickshaw''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|自転車人力|じてんしゃじんりき}}''' ''Jitensha Jinriki'') is the owner of [[Rad Rickshaw's Cycle Shop]] in [[Eterna City]]. ==In the games== If the player visits the Cycle Shop upon first visiting Eterna City, Rad is nowhere to be seen. He can be found arguing with [[Team Galactic]], campaigning them to return Pokémon that have been stolen from Eterna's Trainers (including his own {{p|Clefairy}}). After the player has earned the {{badge|Forest}}, they can use {{HM|01|Cut}} to get past the barricade of trees at the entrance to the [[Team Galactic Eterna Building]]. Once the {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s, {{tc|Scientist}}s, and {{tc|Commander}} [[Jupiter]] have been defeated, all the Pokémon are returned to their Trainers. As an act of gratitude, Rad will reward the player with a free [[Bicycle]] from his shop. If spoken with again, he will repeat the instructions for using the different gears of the Bicycle. ====Pokémon==== {| style="float:left; width: 80px" |- | {{ActivePoké|Rad Rickshaw|Clefairy|035Clefairy.png|fairy|size=100px|link=no}} |}{{left clear}} ===Sprites=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{key items color dark}}; background: #{{key items color}}; font-size:80%;" |- | style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{key items color dark}}; background: #{{key items color light}}; height:80px; width:80px;"| [[File:Pokéfan m IV OD.png]] |- | Overworld sprite from
{{color2|000000|Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Versions|Diamond, Pearl}}, and {{color2|000000|Pokémon Platinum Version|Platinum}} |} ==In the manga== [[File:Sebastian Roseanne Rickshaw Adventures.png|thumb|right|Rad Rickshaw (left) in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===== Rad Rickshaw first appears in ''[[PS347|Ring Around the Roserade II]]'', when [[Cynthia]] frees him from the Team Galactic Grunts that were keeping him tied in the Team Galactic Eterna Building. She cuts the ropes using [[Tru]]'s {{m|Razor Leaf}} that her {{p|Spiritomb}} kept by using {{m|Psychic}}. After being freed, he notices that there is rice covering the leaves (spat by {{adv|Diamond|Dia}} on Tru's back), and identifies it as being from [[Twinleaf Town]]. After {{adv|Platinum|Lady Berlitz}} gets her Forest Badge, Rad appears to the {{DL|Pokédex holder|Sinnoh Pokédex holders}}, believing they were the ones who saved him, and sends them three Bicycles as a token of gratitude. Later in ''[[PS389|Cautious Clefairy]]'', [[Mr. Fuego]] asks {{adv|Pearl}} to deliver some nuts and bolts ordered by Rad Rickshaw. Pearl decides to use the opportunity to understand Team Galactic's intentions on kidnapping him back then. Arriving at Eterna City, he gets attacked by two Clefairy but, before hitting them back, Rad appears to stop him. He tells that the reason of his kidnapping was probably his Pokémon, Cliff and Cliffette, since the Clefairy are said to have come from the moon and he thinks they were collecting anything related to space. Pearl explains about his plan on preventing the release of the Galactic Bomb, and Rad decides to go with him on a tandem bike to make him arrive faster at [[Lake Valor]]. On their way, he tells Pearl about the {{DL|Eterna City|Ancient Statue}} in Eterna City, and how he was interrogated about it by Team Galactic, since its history is well-known by the Rickshaw family. Upon arriving, Pearl bids farewell and goes to the center of the Lake, leaving Rad Rickshaw only to be attacked by [[Saturn]]'s {{p|Octillery}}, being taken hostage again by Team Galactic. The Galactic Bomb explodes, but Rad is saved by Cliff and Cliffette. When he wakes up, he finds Pearl fallen in the middle of the Lake but doesn't know if he must chase the villains or help Pearl. To solve his confusion, [[Crasher Wake]] appears before him, making Rad overjoyed for seeing his idol. Later in ''[[PS403|Cleaning Up Grimer]]'', he gives Pearl a repaired Bicycle for him to go after Team Galactic. ====={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===== Rad Rickshaw last appears in ''[[PS432|Alternate Dimension Showdown II]]'', being injured by {{p|Giratina}}'s rampage in Eterna City and rescued by his Pokémon once again. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Rad |pkmn=Clefairy |nick=Cliff and Cliffette |cynick=Pippirin and Pippiran |type1=Normal |img=Rad Rickshaw Clefairy Adventures.png |epnum=PS389 |epname=Cautious Clefairy |desc=Rad Rickshaw owns two {{p|Clefairy}} nicknamed '''Cliff''' (Jp: '''ピッピりん''' ''Pippirin'') and '''Cliffette''' (Jp: '''ピッピらん''' ''Pippiran'').
